system.name: STeP
system.one_liner: a streaming dataflow abstraction with flexible routing operators, an explicit memory hierarchy, and symbolic-shape semantics that lets dynamic tensor workloads run efficiently on spatial dataflow accelerators

content.subject: a STeP graph routing input to experts, tiling and loading one expert's weights, computing, then reassembling outputs

elements.name: Partition
elements.role: splits the input stream into per-expert sub-streams using a selector stream

elements.name: Expert 1
elements.role: collapsed placeholder representing another routed expert's identical pipeline, drawn without internal detail

elements.name: Expert 2
elements.role: container for one routed expert's fully detailed tile-and-compute pipeline

elements.name: Flatten (0D, 1D)
elements.role: flattens a stream's leading dimensions; drawn once for the routed activations and again for the loaded weight tile

elements.name: Reshape (rank=0, chunk=4, pad=Zero(1,64))
elements.role: reshapes and zero-pads the flattened activation stream into 4-element chunks for tiling

elements.name: Accum (fn: RetileRow)
elements.role: retiles rows of a stream into tiles; instantiated once for the padded path and once for the reshaped tile path

elements.name: LinearOffChipLoadRef
elements.role: loads this expert's weight tile from off-chip memory, referenced against the accumulated activation rows

elements.name: Reshape (r=0, c=1)
elements.role: reshapes the accumulated activation tile ahead of broadcasting it to the weight

elements.name: Expand (n=4)
elements.role: broadcasts the loaded weight tile by a factor of 4 to match the activation tiling

elements.name: Map (fn: matmul)
elements.role: applies matrix multiply across the expanded activation and weight tiles

elements.name: Accum (1D) (fn: RetileCol)
elements.role: retiles the matmul output's columns back into tile layout

elements.name: Flatmap (fn: RetileStreamify)
elements.role: flattens the retiled tile back into a plain output stream for this expert

elements.name: Reassemble
elements.role: merges every expert's output stream, including the collapsed Expert 1 path, back into one output stream

content.key_idea: A STeP program graph shows one expert's full tile pipeline (flatten, reshape, accumulate, load its off-chip weight, matmul, retile) fully drawn while a sibling expert is left collapsed, and both outputs merge back together at Reassemble.
content.reading_order: Top to bottom following the arrows: Partition splits by expert; follow Expert 2's detailed column downward through tiling, weight load, matmul and retiling to Reassemble at the bottom.

summary: This figure shows one STeP program's dataflow graph, opened up in full operator-by-operator detail. At the top, Partition routes an incoming stream to per-expert sub-streams using a selector stream; Expert 1 is left an empty grey placeholder while Expert 2 shows the complete pipeline. Inside Expert 2, activations are flattened, reshaped and zero-padded into 4-element chunks, then two parallel Accum (RetileRow) steps retile the rows; one path feeds LinearOffChipLoadRef, loading that expert's weight tile, while the other reshapes and expands the activations for broadcast. A Map (matmul) combines them, followed by Accum (RetileCol) and Flatmap (RetileStreamify) to retile the result into a plain stream. Every edge is annotated with the tensor shape it carries, and curly braces on the right name each phase: Route, Pack to Tile, Broadcast & Load weight, Compute, Pack Tile, Unpack Tile, and Merge. Both experts' outputs converge at Reassemble.
